DM_DESC:
Hello **{user}**! Music service is now ready in **{guild}**.
Here is the quick administration guide:
DM_QUICKSTART_VAL:
• Use `/play <song/url>` in a voice channel to play music and bring up the control panel.
• Supports YouTube, StreetVoice, KKBOX, Spotify, etc.
• Audio Purity engine automatically filters live concerts and unofficial covers.
DM_PERM_VAL:
• Available to all members by default; manage permissions under Server Settings -> Integrations.
• Administrators and requesters hold skip and queue control privileges.
WELCOME_DESC: Universal platform streaming, lossless HLS extraction, and pure audio filters are ready!
WELCOME_TUTORIAL_VAL:
1. Join any voice channel.
2. Use `/play <song/url>` to queue tracks.
3. The interactive panel allows instant control (EQ, ±15s seek, loops, skips).
WELCOME_HIGHLIGHT_VAL:
• **Platforms**: YouTube, Bilibili, StreetVoice, KKBOX, Spotify, Apple Music
• **Purity Filter**: Eliminates live recordings and low-quality covers
• **Autoplay**: Seamless radio transitions upon queue completion
WELCOME_OFFICIAL_VAL:
• [Official Website](https://musicbot.bybaoge.com/)
• [Donate](https://donate.bybaoge.com/)
• [Official Discord](https://discord.gg/92BB9zGRmS)
• Questions or suggestions? Join our official community!
